instruction.text: Round the number to the nearest ten. Choose the correct number quickly.

hint.text:
If the last digit of the number is 1, 2, 3 or 4, then the number is rounded down to the ten before.

If the last digit of the number is 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9, then the number is rounded up to the next ten.
